name: decimen-optical-transfer
description: Offline file and text transfer using fountain-coded animated QR codes and screen/window capture.

scripts.build:standalone: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-standalone',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc && vite build --mode standalone-send && vite build --mode standalone-receive
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:standalone
scripts.build:text: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build --mode text
scripts.build:text:standalone: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-text-standalone',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc && vite build --mode text-standalone-send && vite build --mode text-standalone-receive
scripts.build:text:all: npm run build:text && npm run build:text:standalone
scripts.desktop:kylin: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux deb --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:win7: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.win7.yml --win --x64 --publish never && node build/verify-win7.cjs
scripts.desktop:win:installer: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:win7:installer: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.win7.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node build/verify-win7.cjs --installer
scripts.desktop:win:all: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win portable nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:win7:all: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.win7.yml --win portable nsis --x64 --publish never && node build/verify-win7.cjs --all
scripts.desktop:text:kylin: npm run build:text && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.text.yml --linux deb --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:text:mac: npm run build:text && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.text.yml --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:text:win: npm run build:text && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.text.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:text:win7: npm run build:text && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.text-win7.yml --win --x64 --publish never && node build/verify-win7.cjs --text
scripts.desktop:text:win:installer: npm run build:text && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.text.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:text:win7:installer: npm run build:text && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.text-win7.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node build/verify-win7.cjs --text --installer
scripts.desktop:text:win:all: npm run build:text && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.text.yml --win portable nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:text:win7:all: npm run build:text && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.text-win7.yml --win portable nsis --x64 --publish never && node build/verify-win7.cjs --text --all
